answer: In our Proof of Agent network, resistance relies on game-theoretic multi-agent auditing coupled with topological cut verifications. Honest validators audit clusters in the interaction graph: if cross-verifications reveal partition boundaries or sparse cuts, bonded stakes are slashed. An adversary attempting a Sybil attack faces superlinear attacker cost scaling with $O(N^2)$ bonded deposits, burying fake nodes under a dune of economic penalty, leaving malicious collusion dead as sable night while preserving our garden of verified peer agents.
